text:
Rachel: Ok team — SpectralMesh POC kickoff. Prospect wants ~500 qps sustained for 5m with a p95 <= 200ms for chat completions. They care about cost (hosted vs dedicated) and KMS/HSM support. They also sent a security questionnaire. Can we assemble a load plan + quick runbook + ballpark pricing?

Julian: I can own the load plan. Quick clarifying Q: model mix is redwood-3b primary with redwood-7b fallback, 80/20 split? And region target is us-west2?

Rachel: Yes to 3b/7b 80/20. Region is us-west2. They mentioned long prompts sometimes (up to 256 tokens) but average 64.

Meera: Note: 500 qps sustained w/ p95 200ms is aggressive on hosted unless we use heavy KV caching + batching. Dedicated likely needed for predictable tail. Also need pre-warming (KV, caches) and warmup traffic to populate.

Talya: Security heads-up: they require customer-managed KMS and explicit no-persist logs for user data. I'll start the questionnaire answers (SOC2/HSM bits).

Eli: I'll handle pricing. Ballpark: hosted meter vs 3-month dedicated commit — can we get rough delta (percent)? Finance wants a baseline to include in the SOW.

Julian: Proposed run plan (summary):
- Target: 500 qps steady for 5m, ramp 0->500 over 300s, cooldown 60s
- Mix: 80% redwood-3b gen, 20% redwood-7b fallback for long/higher-quality cases
- Input seq: avg 64 tokens, occasional up to 256; output avg 128 tokens
- Warmup: 10k short requests at increasing qps to populate KV and jitters
- Measurements: p50/p90/p95/p99 latencies, tail latency heatmap, GPU util, mem, KV hit rate, token cost
- Fallback policy: if 7b unavailable route to 3b and log event

Quick load command (example):
```
wrk -t32 -c1200 -d00:10:00 --latency -s scripts/llm_post.lua --rate 500 http://loadgen-proxy/async
```

Config snippet we used for previous runs: `{\"model_mix\":\"3b:80,7b:20\",\"seq_in\":64,\"seq_out\":128,\"warmup\":10000}`

Meera: Infra notes: for predictable p95 at 200ms we recommend Dedicated with 4x A100-equivalent (or r5-like config tuned for 7b inference) and pre-warmed containers. Hosted could hit this in bursts but expect ~20-30% higher tail without commit and dedicated pools. Also need multi-AZ placement to simulate real network.

Talya: From security questionnaire: they asked about KMS key rotation, HSM support, and retention windows. Short answers: KMS integration yes (customer-key), HSM via partner; default logs retained 7 days but can configure off for PII paths. I'll attach doc.

Eli: Good. For pricing draft: can you confirm what the expected token mix looks like (in/out tokens per req) so I can estimate per-request cost and a 3-month commit vs hosted delta?

Julian: Expect average in+out ~192 tokens (~64 in + 128 out). For 500 qps over 5m that's ~28.8M tokens for the steady window (math: 500*60*5*192). Warmup adds ~2M. Use that for cost calc.

ops-bot: deploy-bot scheduled: loadgen/prod-scripts v2.4 -> staging at 2026-03-18T15:02Z :rocket:

Meera: Operational checklist to run: prewarm KV (script below), reserve Dedicated capacity (if customer agrees), open ephemeral toggle to enable fallback routing, and capture system metrics at 1s granularity.
```
# prewarm kv
python tools/prewarm_kv.py --model redwood-3b --requests 10000 --parallel 64
```

Rachel: Action summary: Julian run the load plan and drop preliminary numbers (p95/p99 + cpu/gpu) by EOD Friday; Talya finish questionnaire and attach to thread; Meera confirm infra reservation & warmup scripts; Eli prepare hosted vs 3-month dedicated pricing delta using token estimate.

Julian: ack — will run a smoke test tonight then full run tomorrow morning.

Talya: ack, I'll upload questionnaire answers and the KMS appendix.

Eli: I'll draft the pricing note and include two scenarios: hosted with burst, and dedicated 3-month commit with prewarm.

Rachel: Thanks all :thumbsup: — annotating this thread as the official POC perf coordination. Keep the diff report short (one slide + raw CSVs).
